- A license is required for any property storing ten (10) or more vehicles, where the vehicle owner
is charged a fee and is open to the general public.

- At each public entrance there will be a sign with the following information: Name of the licensee,
hours of the day/night when the facility is open, rate charged, closing hour, if there are multiple
rates to be charged they will all be in the same font size and dimension not less than six (6) inches
in height.
- Change from day to night rate will not be effective before 5:30pm and notice shall be on the
signs.
- Rates and charges, and maximum rates will be in dollars and cents, not solely time.
- Any change to the rates or rate schedule must be filed with the City Clerk’s office at least
thirty (30) days prior to change.

- Lot must be enclosed with a fence, wall or other barrier so that vehicles may only enter/exit at
established entrances/exits.
- Lot must be paved and properly drained.
Completed Parking Facility Application (part I and part II).
